checks.evidence: The result keeps the reference's long dark hair framing, overall face length, eye spacing, nose and lip placement, and adult presentation visually consistent. The rendered eyes read slightly rounder and the lower face slightly narrower at this scale, so this is appearance consistency rather than a claim of identity.
One fully dressed adult woman, the wet flood-control underpass, two-handed translucent city plan, teal and amber civic lighting, and a vast suspended wave of window bays are immediately legible.

Her left support leg (viewer-right) is straight and her relaxed right boot (viewer-left) rests on the curb, but the plan obscures the pelvis enough that the opposed pelvis-shoulder counter-tilt is not clearly verifiable at thumbnail scale.
The plan and coat occupy most of the forearm-to-waist region; no clean triangular patch of continuous teal-lit scene background survives as a recognizable arm-waist void.

The overhead windows form a strong single curling arc and the plan bows separately, but the frame does not read as one continuous two-curve planar S-route through wave, plan edge, and coat hem. This is not a promoted profile gate.

Both hands plausibly grip the sheet, legs and boots are structurally coherent, wet concrete and raincoat materials are convincing, and the plan carries map-like linework without prominent malformed readable text.
